description: The first Kunikaze survey aircraft introduced in 1960 and retired in FY1983; operated on behalf of the Ministry of Construction by the JMSDF which is why it carries the naval serial 9101; it also held the civil registration JA5061 from 8 Mar 1960 to 12 Nov 1966 and carried the JMSDF number from 2 Oct 1960
